characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Exclusive (Caiman Elders).
The Caiman Mentor model part gains Weapon Master, and Tooth and Claw, Halberd, Great Weapon.
While the Caiman Mentor model part is using a Melee Weapon without a Weapon Enchantment, add the following rules to the weapon, depending on the weapon used:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Courage and Command Tests taken by the model’s unit are Minimised, and may use the Discipline from other units within 8", following the rules below:
  • Choose a single model in the unit to take the test for the whole unit, as usual.
  • Determine the model with the highest Discipline value in any other friendly, non-Shaken unit within 8".
  • Set the Discipline value of the model chosen in step 1 above to the value determined in step 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Choose one of the effects below to apply, with Duration: End of Turn.
All models in the unit must choose and activate the same effect simultaneously.
  • May be activated during Choosing Equipment and Abilities.
The model gains Grind Attack (1, Str 2, AP 3, Unmodifiable); if it is in the second rank and not in contact with any enemy model, it can make its Grind Attack across models in the first rank directly in front of it.
  • May be activated in the Shooting Phase. The model gains the following Shooting Weapon:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model is a Wizard Apprentice with access to Druidism, Shamanism, Evocation. It can select its spells from the Apprentice Spell and Adept Spells (#1-#4) from its chosen Path. This replaces the normal rules for Spell Selection connected to being a Wizard Apprentice.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The model’s Casting Rolls for Learned Spells gains a +1 modifier.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Extra Support replaces the limit on the maximum number of attacks the model can do as Restricted Attack with the value in brackets (X) or, if it includes a +, increases that limit with +X.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Learned Spells cast by the model gain +6" Range (spells with Type “Aura” gain +3" Range instead).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
During its First Round of Combat, any model part with First Strike, or using a weapon with First Strike, gains the Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets.
For example, a model part with First Strike (+1 Str) gains +1 Str in its First Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Select either Pyromancy,Occultism: the model knows one additional spell from the selected Path, which must be selected from the Apprentice Spell and Adept Spells (#1--#4).

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
The wielder benefits from an increase to: Str, AP and Att by 1 for every spell with Duration: One Turn currently affecting the wielder's model and/or enemy units in contact with the wielder.
Note: The number of spells is determined at the start of the wielder's Agility Step.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Exclusive (Tegu Warriors),War Platform, and it loses Stubborn. In addition, all Rank-and-File models in its unit benefit from Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Counts has a Hand Weapon with the following additional rules: +1 Str, +1 AP, and Agility is always 0.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: At the start of each friendly Player Turn, the model may choose a friendly unit entirely with Magnasaur within 12": the unit must reroll failed Charge Range rolls and loses Frenzy (if it has it), with Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model becomes an Attachable Model, gains Exclusive (Raptor Pack, Raptor Riders), and loses Solitary.
While the model is joined to a unit of Raptor Pack or Raptor Riders, the model gains Pack Hunter.
Model parts with Magnasaur in the model’s unit gain Fury.
No more than a single model with Hunt Leader can ever be joined to the same unit.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
Once per friendly Magic Phase, the model may choose a Learned Spell that was successfully cast by an enemy Wizard in the previous Magic Phase: the model knows the chosen spell, with Duration: One Phase.
Hereditary Spells cannot be chosen.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: No more than two models with Mentor can ever be joined to the same unit.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
Health Point losses caused by the attack are multiplied into the value given in brackets (X). If the value is a dice, roll one dice for each unsaved wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds.
The number of Health Point losses that the attack is multiplied into can never be higher than the Health Points Characteristic of the target (excluding Health Points lost previously in the battle).
For example, if an attack with Multiple Wounds (D6) wounds a unit of Trolls (HP 3) and rolls a ‘5’ for the multiplier, the number of Health Points lost is reduced to 3, even if the Troll unit has already lost one or two Health Points previously in battle.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Your first failed Dispelling Roll during each enemy Magic Phase must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Units entirely with Pack Hunter must reroll failed Charge Range rolls if either or both of the following apply:
  • Its Charge is part of a Combined Charge.
  • Its Charge is Declared towards a unit that is already Engaged in Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part can allocate its Stomp Attack onto Health Pools of Height 4 or less (rather than 0-1).
If the model part’s Stomp Attack is allocated towards a Health Pool with Height (3–4), the total number of its hits is halved, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: End of Turn.
May be activated at the start of any Charge Phase. Select a single friendly unit containing models with Height 4-5 within 18": all model parts with Height 4-5 in the selected unit lose Stomp Attack and gains Impact Hits (X), where X is equal to the amount of hits from its Stomp Attack (if a model part already had Impact Hits, increase the number of hits by its amount of Stomp Attack instead).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
When a model with Sweeping Attack is within 1" of an Unengaged enemy unit during a Move Manoeuvre (even temporarily), the model’s unit may perform a Sweeping Attack against that enemy unit. This can only be used once per friendly Player Turn.
Resolve the Sweeping Attack when the Move Manoeuvre is completed. The attack hits automatically, and counts as a Ranged Attack.
Each model part in the unit with Sweeping Attack must use it towards the same enemy unit. The attack causes X hits, resolved with the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons.
If values for Strength, Armour Penetration and additional Attack Attributes are defined in the bracket (Y), these are used instead. In this case, the Sweeping Attack is Unmodifiable.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
May be activated when a friendly unit fails a Break Test (after any rerolls): enemy units within 18" of the bearer have their Charge Range, Pursuit Distance, and Overrun Distance rolls Minimised.

characteristics.$text: +1 Att, +1 to hit, Two-Handed. This weapon cannot be enchanted with Weapon Enchantments.
